[EN] A sword is just a tool, you know.

A tool for slicing, stabbing, chopping, piercing, beheading, disembowelling, amputating, carving, skewering, severing, and slashing.

A very versatile tool, in other words.
[ES] Una espada es solo una herramienta, ya sabes.

Una herramienta para cortar, apuñalar, picar, perforar, decapitar, destripar, amputar, tallar, ensartar, seccionar y tajar.

Una herramienta muy versátil, en otras palabras.
